projects.title: self-hosted vps
projects.description: built a self-hosted environment on DigitalOcean to gain hands-on experience running containerized services, setting up zero trust security and observability.

details.implementation: the setup combines Docker to containerize a public-facing n8n CE for automation workflows with storage persistence, and implemented a zero-trust architecture by routing traffic through Cloudflare Tunnel while Tailscale manages secure droplet access. system metrics are fed via Datadog API to a centralized dashboard for real-time infrastructure monitoring.
